createHouse.title: Found your house
createHouse.intro: You land as a metic in the city that welcomes you. Give your oikos a name and a blazon.
createHouse.name: House name
createHouse.nameHint: 3 to 24 characters: letters, spaces, apostrophes and hyphens.

home.title: House {{name}}
home.recipeChanged: Production changed: {{site}}. A new cycle begins.
home.limitReached: Your house already runs as many sites as its headquarters allows.
home.alreadyAcquired: This site was already acquired: {{site}}, for {{cost}} obols. Nothing more was paid.
home.held: plus {{amount}} obols held for your resting buy orders at the agora

agora.title: Agora of {{city}}
agora.cancelOrder: Cancel the sale of {{remaining}} × {{good}} at {{price}} obols
agora.cancelled: Sale cancelled: {{quantity}} × {{good}} back in free stock.
agora.boughtPartly: Partial purchase: {{quantity}} × {{good}} out of {{wanted}} for {{amount}} obols. The rest is waiting in the book; {{held}} obols are held to pay for it.
agora.boughtShort: Partial purchase: {{quantity}} × {{good}} out of {{wanted}} for {{amount}} obols. Your treasury could neither pay for more nor hold the price of the rest.
agora.bidsCaption: Resting buy orders, highest bid first
agora.cancelBuyOrder: Cancel the purchase of {{remaining}} × {{good}} at {{price}} obols
agora.cancelledBuy: Purchase cancelled: {{quantity}} × {{good}}; {{amount}} obols returned to your treasury.
agora.soldPartly: Partly sold: {{quantity}} × {{good}} out of {{wanted}} for {{amount}} obols. The rest is waiting in the book.
agora.placedBuy: Buy order waiting: {{quantity}} × {{good}} at {{price}} obols. {{held}} obols are held until it is filled or cancelled.
agora.soldGross: Sold: {{quantity}} × {{good}} for {{amount}} obols before market tax.
agora.soldPartlyGross: Partly sold: {{quantity}} × {{good}} out of {{wanted}} for {{amount}} obols before market tax. The rest is waiting in the book.
agora.expectedNet: Expected net: {{net}} obols ({{gross}} less {{tax}} in market tax), if the sale is filled in a single trade. Filled in several trades, it may bring in a few obols less.
agora.priceEmpty: No price to show yet: the history is updated at each tick, from the trades.
agora.changeUnknown: 24 h change: unknown, the history is too short.
agora.chartLabel_one: Candlesticks: {{good}}, {{count}} period, from {{from}} to {{to}}, prices in obols from {{low}} to {{high}}. The price table gives the same values.
agora.chartLabel_other: Candlesticks: {{good}}, {{count}} periods, from {{from}} to {{to}}, prices in obols from {{low}} to {{high}}. The price table gives the same values.
agora.chartLegend: Hollow body: closed higher. Filled body: closed lower. Single line: closed where it opened. Logarithmic scale, in obols: {{low}} to {{high}}.
agora.observedPrice: Average price over {{hours}} h, in obols: {{price}} (volume traded: {{volume}}).
agora.observedPriceDated: Last average price computed, as of {{date}}, in obols: {{price}} (volume traded in {{hours}} h: {{volume}}). No trade since.
